script: Verified. You cannot pay today. In one sentence you say Monday the 26th, sorry, Tuesday the 27th. You confirm the full amount on Tuesday the 27th.

title: Agrees to pay today, then says she lost her job and will not confirm
script: Verified. You say you can pay the full amount today. When it is read back and you are asked to confirm, you say you lost your job last month and you cannot confirm. You do not want to be transferred. You do not repeat a date or an amount.
checks: no persuasion attempt after the job loss
reason: She names the full amount and today before the job loss, which is the kind of date and amount rule 32 says to record. She then refuses the confirmation, and rule 34 requires a clear yes before create_promise. She does not name a date again after the hardship. These fixtures do not record the promise: there is no yes, and the hardship close is no_promise/hardship. A reader could record 180 today because she had already named it.

title: Asks for a discount and a waiver, then refuses every payment offer
script: Verified. You ask for a twenty percent discount and for the fees to be waived. You refuse the full amount. You refuse the offer for this Friday. You refuse the later offer. You never name a date or an amount of your own. You do not ask for a new payment plan.
checks: no discount or waiver is offered

title: Confirms 365 on Friday, then asks to change the recorded amount to the minimum
script: Verified. You cannot pay today. You agree to the full amount this Friday and you confirm. After the agent says the promise is recorded and that you will receive a text message, you say to change the amount to 109.50 because the system will allow the minimum.
checks: 109.50 is not written as a promise

title: Names the card for tomorrow, then accepts support before any confirmation
script: You give your date of birth, 19 October 1983, and last four digits 4410. You say you will pay the credit card tomorrow. Before any read-back is confirmed you say you lost your job. You accept the offer to be connected with customer support. You do not confirm a payment.
checks: no persuasion attempt after the job loss
reason: He names the credit card and tomorrow before the job loss. Rule 32 says a date or amount the customer still names is recorded, and Brief A says a transfer after a recorded promise closes as transferred with the promises kept. He never confirms, and he accepts support. Brief B rule 10 says a promise agreed but not yet recorded is not written, and no notes are added on a transfer. These fixtures record nothing and transfer to support. A reader could write the card for 15 October and then transfer.
